import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int MAX_N = 15; // max n from problem constraints
    static final int MAX_T = 64; // max t from problem constraints

    static int n, t;
    static int[][] sci = new int[MAX_N+1][MAX_N+1];
    static int[][] cap = new int[MAX_N+1][MAX_N+1];
    static int[][][] maze = new int[MAX_T+1][MAX_N+1][MAX_N+1];
    static boolean[][][][][] dp = new boolean[MAX_T+1][MAX_N+1][MAX_N+1][MAX_N+1][MAX_N+1];
    static boolean[][] vis = new boolean[MAX_N+1][MAX_N+1];
    
    // Dinic structures
    static int maxNodes;
    static int st, ed;
    static int[] head;
    static int[] to, w, nxt;
    static int cnt;
    static int[] d, now;
    
    static final int[][] dir = {{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};
    
    static int get_id(int x, int y, int k) {
        return (x-1)*n + y + k*n*n;
    }
    
    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow) {
        to[cnt] = v;
        w[cnt] = flow;
        nxt[cnt] = head[u];
        head[u] = cnt++;
        to[cnt] = u;
        w[cnt] = 0;
        nxt[cnt] = head[v];
        head[v] = cnt++;
    }
    
    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(d, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(st);
        now[st] = head[st];
        d[st] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                int v = to[i];
                if (d[v] == 0 && w[i] > 0) {
                    d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                    now[v] = head[v];
                    q.add(v);
                    if (v == ed) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static int dinic(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == ed) return flow;
        int rest = flow;
        for (int i = now[u]; i != -1 && rest > 0; i = nxt[i]) {
            now[u] = i;
            int v = to[i];
            if (w[i] > 0 && d[v] == d[u] + 1) {
                int k = dinic(v, Math.min(rest, w[i]));
                if (k == 0) {
                    d[v] = 0;
                } else {
                    w[i] -= k;
                    w[i^1] += k;
                    rest -= k;
                }
            }
        }
        return flow - rest;
    }
    
    static int maxFlow() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            int flow;
            while ((flow = dinic(st, INF)) > 0) {
                ans += flow;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    static void dfsReach(int sx, int sy, int x, int y, int step) {
        vis[x][y] = true;
        dp[step][sx][sy][x][y] = true;
        if (step >= t || maze[step][x][y] != 0) return;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            int nx = x + dir[k][0];
            int ny = y + dir[k][1];
            if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx > n || ny > n) continue;
            if (vis[nx][ny]) continue;
            if (maze[step][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
            dfsReach(sx, sy, nx, ny, step+1);
        }
    }
    
    static void init() {
        // Propagate Z over time
        for (int time = 1; time <= t; time++) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                    if (maze[time-1][x][y] != 0) {
                        maze[time][x][y] = maze[time-1][x][y];
                    } else {
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                            int nx = x + dir[k][0];
                            int ny = y + dir[k][1];
                            if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx > n || ny > n) continue;
                            if (maze[time-1][nx][ny] == 2) {
                                maze[time][x][y] = 2;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // Run DFS for each scientist
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int a = 1; a <= n; a++) Arrays.fill(vis[a], false);
                    dfsReach(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        // Propagate reachability over steps
        for (int i = 1; i <= t; i++) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                    for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; xx++) {
                        for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; yy++) {
                            dp[i][x][y][xx][yy] |= dp[i-1][x][y][xx][yy];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        // Read maze/sci
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                    sci[i][j] = c - '0';
                } else if (c == 'Y') {
                    maze[0][i][j] = 1;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    maze[0][i][j] = 2;
                }
            }
        }
        // Read cap
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                    cap[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        
        init();
        maxNodes = 2 + 2*n*n;
        st = maxNodes - 1;
        ed = maxNodes - 2;
        head = new int[maxNodes+5];
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        int maxEdges = 200000;
        to = new int[maxEdges];
        w = new int[maxEdges];
        nxt = new int[maxEdges];
        d = new int[maxNodes+5];
        now = new int[maxNodes+5];
        cnt = 0;
        
        // Add source to scientist edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    addEdge(st, get_id(i, j, 0), sci[i][j]);
                }
                if (cap[i][j] != 0) {
                    addEdge(get_id(i, j, 1), ed, cap[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        // Add scientist-capsule edges if reachable
        for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; xx++) {
                    for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; yy++) {
                        if (sci[x][y] != 0 && cap[xx][yy] != 0 && dp[t][x][y][xx][yy]) {
                            addEdge(get_id(x, y, 0), get_id(xx, yy, 1), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxFlow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
